Messages:
  - **RedOrrange** is a real-time, WhatsApp-like messaging application featuring individual and group chats, status updates, and WebRTC-based voice/video calls.

### 🚀 Core Technologies
*   **Backend**: [Flask 2.3.3](https://flask.palletsprojects.com/) (Python) using an application factory pattern.
*   **Frontend**: [React 18.2.0](https://react.dev/) (JavaScript) initialized via `create-react-app` (`react-scripts`).
*   **Real-time Communication**: [Socket.IO](https://socket.io/) (Flask-SocketIO on backend, socket.io-client on frontend) for messaging, typing indicators, and status updates.
*   **Voice/Video Calls**: [WebRTC](https://webrtc.org/) (signaling via Socket.IO, frontend implementation in `useWebRTC.js`).
*   **Database**: [PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/) (Production) and [SQLite](https://www.sqlite.org/) (Development) managed via [Flask-SQLAlchemy](https://flask-sqlalchemy.palletsprojects.com/) (SQLAlchemy 2.0).
*   **Authentication**: JWT-based (using [Flask-JWT-Extended](https://flask-jwt-extended.readthedocs.io/)).
*   **State Management**: [Zustand](https://github.com/pmndrs/zustand) (Frontend).
*   **Styling**: [Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/) with [Framer Motion](https://www.framer.com/motion/) for animations.
*   **External Services**: African Talking API (SMS), Mapbox (Live Location), and Web Push notifications.

### 📦 Package Management & Build System
*   **Backend**:
    *   **Package Manager**: `pip` (dependencies defined in `backend/requirements.txt`).
    *   **Build/Runner**: `gunicorn` with `eventlet` worker for production; `run.py` (Flask development server) for local development.
*   **Frontend**:
    *   **Package Manager**: `npm` (dependencies in `frontend/package.json`).
    *   **Build System**: `react-scripts` (Webpack-based).

├── backend/                # Flask Application
│   ├── app/                # Core logic
│   │   ├── models/         # SQLAlchemy Database models

│   │   └── utils/          # Push notifications, QR codes, VAPID keys
│   ├── config.py           # Environment-based configuration
│   ├── run.py              # Development entry point (port 8000)
│   ├── wsgi.py             # Production entry point
│   └── requirements.txt    # Python dependencies
├── frontend/               # React Application

│   ├── src/

│   │   ├── pages/          # View-level components (LoginPage, ChatPage)
│   │   ├── services/       # API, Socket, and Zustand store (store.js)
│   │   ├── hooks/          # Custom hooks (useWebRTC.js)
│   │   └── data/           # Static data (country codes)
│   ├── tailwind.config.js  # CSS configuration
│   └── package.json        # JS dependencies and scripts
├── render.yaml             # Render.com deployment configuration
└── start.sh                # Utility script to install and run both tiers
```

*   **JavaScript (ES6+)**: Frontend application logic.

     6→## Overview

     8→A workflow binds a shell command (e.g., `npm run dev`, `python run.py`, `cargo run`) to a long-running task managed by Replit. Workflows are used to run webservers, background services, TUIs, and other persistent processes.

    10→**Key characteristics:**
    11→
    12→- Workflows run until explicitly stopped
    13→- The system tracks workflows automatically — no separate configuration file is required
    14→- Workflows auto-restart after package installation and module installation
    15→- You can only get console logs from a workflow if it is running
    16→
    17→## Setup Tips
    18→
    19→1. **Keep workflows minimal**: One workflow per project is usually sufficient. Use the main frontend server or TUI as your primary workflow.

    22→
    23→3. **Clean up unused workflows**: When adding new workflows, remove any existing workflows that are no longer needed.
    24→

    31→Use this skill when:

    33→- You need to create or configure a workflow (background process)
    34→- You need to restart the application after making code changes
    35→- The application needs to be restarted to pick up new environment variables

    94→### configureWorkflow({ name, command, waitForPort, outputType, autoStart, isCanvasWorkflow })

    96→Configure or create a workflow. This is the primary way to set up background processes.

    98→**Parameters:**

   103→- `outputType` (str, default "webview"): "webview", "console", or "vnc"

   186→1. **Restart after code changes**: Always restart workflows after modifying server-side code

# Bitese — WhatsApp-like Messaging App

Bitese is a full-stack, real-time messaging platform built with React and Flask. It supports one-on-one and group messaging, voice/video calls, file attachments, and live status updates.

---

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | React 18, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Zustand |
| Backend | Flask, Flask-SocketIO, Flask-JWT-Extended |
| Database | SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod) |
| Real-time | WebSocket (Socket.IO) |
| Calling | WebRTC (STUN/TURN mesh) |

---

## Features

### Messaging
- One-to-one and group chat
- Text, image, video, audio, document, and voice note messages
- Attachment preview before sending (with optional caption)
- Reply, forward, edit, delete (for me / for everyone)
- Emoji reactions and emoji picker
- Message search within conversations
- Link previews with metadata scraping
- Read receipts (single tick → double tick → blue ticks)
- Typing indicators
- Location sharing
- Paginated message history

### Calls
- One-to-one WebRTC voice and video calls
- **Group voice/video calls** (mesh topology, up to ~8 participants)
- STUN + TURN ice servers for NAT traversal
- Minimizable call screen
- Mute / camera toggle / speaker controls
- Call history with call-back

### Status
- 24-hour expiring status updates (text with colour background)
- Status views tracking
- Full-screen status viewer with progress bars

### Security
- JWT-based authentication (access + refresh tokens)
- Rate limiting on auth endpoints (Flask-Limiter): 10 req/min login, 5 req/min signup
- Security headers on every response (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Referrer-Policy)
- Input sanitization middleware
- Account ban/unban via admin panel

### Other
- WhatsApp-style chat backgrounds / wallpapers
- Push notifications (VAPID web push)
- QR code contact sharing
- Admin dashboard (user management)
- Mobile-responsive design

---

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10+
- Node.js 18+
- pnpm or npm

### Backend

```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env   # fill in JWT_SECRET_KEY and other vars
python run.py
```

Backend runs on **port 8000**.

### Frontend

```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
```

Frontend runs on **port 5000** and proxies API calls to `:8000`.

---

## API Overview

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| POST | `/api/auth/signup` | Register |
| POST | `/api/auth/login` | Login |
| GET | `/api/auth/user` | Current user profile |
| GET | `/api/messages/chat/:id` | Chat history |
| POST | `/api/messages/:id` | Send message |
| POST | `/api/upload/image` | Upload image |
| POST | `/api/upload/video` | Upload video |
| POST | `/api/upload/audio` | Upload audio |
| POST | `/api/upload/document` | Upload document |
| GET | `/api/contacts` | Contact list |
| POST | `/api/contacts` | Add contact |
| GET | `/api/status/all` | All friend statuses |
| POST | `/api/status` | Post status update |

---

## WebSocket Events

### Messaging
- `message` — send a new message
- `new_message` — receive a message
- `typing` / `stop_typing` — typing indicators
- `message_deleted` / `message_edited` — mutation events
- `reaction` / `reaction_added` — emoji reactions

### 1-to-1 Calls
- `call_offer` / `incoming_call`
- `call_answer` / `call_answered`
- `ice_candidate`
- `call_reject` / `call_rejected`
- `call_end` / `call_ended`

### Group Calls
- `group_call_start` — initiate group call
- `group_incoming_call` — notified of incoming group call
- `group_call_join` — join call room
- `group_call_offer` / `group_call_answer` — WebRTC negotiation per peer
- `group_ice_candidate` — ICE relay per peer
- `group_call_leave` / `group_call_user_left`
- `group_call_reject` / `group_call_rejected`

---

## Environment Variables

```env
SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key
JWT_SECRET_KEY=your-jwt-secret
DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///bitese.db
AFRICAS_TALKING_API_KEY=your-at-key
AFRICAS_TALKING_USERNAME=sandbox
VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY=your-vapid-private
VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=your-vapid-public
```

---

- One-to-one and group chat
- Text, image, video, audio, document, and voice note messages
- **Attachment preview before sending** (with optional caption)
- Reply, forward, edit, delete (for me / for everyone)
- Emoji reactions and emoji picker
- Message search within conversations
- Link previews with metadata scraping
- Read receipts (single tick → double tick → blue ticks)
- Typing indicators
- Location sharing
- Paginated message history

### Calls
- One-to-one WebRTC voice and video calls
- **Group voice/video calls** (mesh topology, up to ~8 participants)
- STUN + TURN ICE servers for NAT traversal
- Minimizable call screen during calls
- Mute / camera toggle / speaker controls
- Call history with call-back functionality

### Status
- 24-hour expiring status updates (text with colour backgrounds)
- Status view tracking
- Full-screen status viewer with progress bars

### Security
- JWT-based authentication (access + refresh tokens)
- **Rate limiting on auth endpoints** (Flask-Limiter): 10 req/min on login, 5 req/min on signup
- Security headers on every response: `X-Content-Type-Options`, `X-Frame-Options`, `X-XSS-Protection`, `Referrer-Policy`, `Permissions-Policy`
- Input sanitization middleware
- Account ban/unban via admin panel
- No-scroll fixed login page (no layout shift)

### Other
- WhatsApp-style chat backgrounds / wallpapers
- Push notifications (VAPID web push)
- QR code contact sharing
- Admin dashboard (user management)
- Mobile-responsive design

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites
- Python 3.10+
- Node.js 18+
- npm

### Backend

```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
cp .env.example .env   # fill in JWT_SECRET_KEY and other vars
python run.py
```

Backend runs on **port 8000**.

### Frontend

```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm start
```

Frontend runs on **port 5000** and proxies API calls to `:8000`.

## WebSocket Events

### Messaging
- `message` — send a message
- `new_message` — receive a message
- `typing` / `stop_typing` — typing indicators
- `message_deleted` / `message_edited` — mutation events
- `reaction` / `reaction_added` — emoji reactions

### 1-to-1 Calls
- `call_offer` / `incoming_call`
- `call_answer` / `call_answered`
- `ice_candidate`
- `call_reject` / `call_rejected`
- `call_end` / `call_ended`

### Group Calls
- `group_call_start` — initiate group call, notifies all group members
- `group_incoming_call` — incoming group call notification
- `group_call_join` — join call room
- `group_call_offer` / `group_call_answer` — WebRTC negotiation (per peer pair)
- `group_ice_candidate` — ICE candidate relay (per peer)
- `group_call_leave` / `group_call_user_left` — participant left
- `group_call_reject` / `group_call_rejected` — call declined
